zh.title: 罗小黑战记
tags: 《罗小黑战记2》票房超5.33亿
10余个国家和地区发行
zh.intro: 2023年，中文在线收购《罗小黑战记》出品方寒木春华控股权。通过精细化运营，罗小黑已构建从动画番剧、番外漫画、动画电影到衍生周边的IP闭环生态，逐步成长为完整的IP宇宙。

highlights.v: 动画番剧首播，全网播放量超10亿次
导演MTJJ组建团队，创办寒木春华
第一部电影《罗小黑战记》上映，票房破3.15亿元；入围第44届昂西国际动画电影节（唯一华语入围影片）
日语配音版由Aniplex发行、全线进入日本商业院线，票房突破5.8亿日元
《罗小黑战记2》7月18日在中国大陆上映，票房破5.33亿元，并在美国、加拿大、马来西亚、澳大利亚、新西兰、泰国、日本、印度尼西亚、法国等10余个国家和地区发行
获奥斯卡最佳动画长片参评资格，为名单中唯一一部国产动画片；日语配音版上映3天票房破1亿日元，登上Filmarks首映满意度排行榜第1位
获第二十二届中国国际动漫节“金猴奖”综合奖动画电影金奖；受邀赴英国参加“2026英国·中国电影周”展映
联名王者荣耀、必胜客、泡泡玛特、名创优品、Akko、和平精英等超40家品牌，覆盖餐饮、潮玩、服饰、数码、非遗等领域

en.title: The Legend of Hei
tags: The Legend of Hei 2: RMB 533M+ box office
Released in 10+ countries and regions
en.intro: In 2023 COL acquired a controlling stake in Hanmu Chunhua, the studio behind The Legend of Hei. The franchise now spans an animated series, spin-off comics, feature films and merchandise, growing into a complete IP universe.

stats.label: The Legend of Hei 2 mainland box office

highlights.v: The animated series premieres and goes on to pass 1 billion views
Director MTJJ founds the studio Hanmu Chunhua
The first film grosses over RMB 315 million and is selected for the 44th Annecy International Animation Film Festival (the only Chinese-language film selected)
The Japanese dub, released by Aniplex in Japanese cinemas nationwide, earns over JPY 580 million

The Legend of Hei 2 opens in mainland China on July 18, grosses over RMB 533 million, and is released in 10+ markets including the US, Canada, Malaysia, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Japan, Indonesia and France

Qualifies for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, the only Chinese animation on the list. The Japanese dub passes JPY 100 million in three days and ranks No. 1 on Filmarks’ first-day satisfaction chart
Wins the Gold Award for animated film at the 22nd China International Cartoon & Animation Festival (Golden Monkey Award), and screens at the 2026 UK–China Film Week
Collaborations with 40+ brands including Honor of Kings, Pizza Hut, Pop Mart, MINISO, Akko and Game for Peace, across food, toys, fashion, tech and intangible heritage
